The metric side agrees: Cone.apex_not_euclidean for every α ≠ 2π (GX.conical_metric).

To compute π₁ of a quotient by a free action with simply connected total space, use UniversalCover.deckEquiv, transport the deck group along the homeomorphism of exists_homeomorph_of_simplyConnected (conjugation, GX.deckCongrOfComp), and identify Deck with the acting group: injective by freeness, surjective by IsCoveringMap.eq_of_comp_eq on a connected total space (GX.cylPosDeck_bijective).

A subgroup of order p of a group isomorphic to Circle is μ_p by Lagrange (pow_card_eq_one') + Subgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge + Complex.card_rootsOfUnity; to get the isomorphism for a point-wise stabilizer of an axis, LinearMap.ext_on (span = ⊤) fixes the axis, polarization of a split form q = |w|² + q' kills the cross term, and linear_isometry_complex + det < 0 of conj finishes (GX.linPtStab_rot).
